en: The image is a vintage postcard showing a waterfront scene with several boats on a river or canal, traditional Ottoman-era houses with red-tiled roofs, and a large historic fortress/castle in the background. People in period clothing, some wearing fez hats, are visible along the water's edge and in boats. There is a small bridge and a flag flying on the fortress. The postcard is colorized and has a nostalgic, early 20th-century aesthetic. The text on the postcard is in French and partially in another language.
